title.value: Visually Grounded Reasoning across Languages and Cultures
title.justification: The title is clearly stated on the first page of the paper.
title.quote: Visually Grounded Reasoning across Languages and Cultures

analysis.description: This paper addresses the cultural and linguistic biases in vision-and-language datasets derived from ImageNet by creating a new dataset, MaRVL, which is more representative of a diverse set of languages and cultures. It involves a multifaceted approach that allows native speakers to select the concepts and images, aiming to create a hierarchy of concepts and images beyond the bias present in the Western-focused ImageNet.

type.justification: The study involves the creation of a new dataset by collecting data from multiple languages and cultures, followed by empirical evaluation using this dataset.
type.quote: We establish a series of baselines using state-of-the-art models and find that their cross-lingual transfer performance lags dramatically behind supervised performance in English.

name.justification: The research focuses on vision-and-language tasks, which fall under the domain of multimodal learning.
name.quote: Several pre-trained Transformer models for vision-and-language tasks have been proposed, inspired by the BERT architecture.

name.justification: The work specifically targets reasoning tasks over visual and textual modalities through datasets like MaRVL.
name.quote: Multilingual multimodal datasets. Elliott et al. (2016) introduced Multi30k, one of the most widely used multilingual image-caption datasets.

name.value: Cross-lingual and Multicultural Bias in Datasets
name.justification: The paper addresses biases in existing datasets like ImageNet and proposes a new protocol for constructing culturally and linguistically diverse datasets.
name.quote: Our empirical and theoretical analyses reveal that concepts and images documented in existing visiolinguistic datasets are likely neither salient nor prototypical in many languages different from English and in cultures outside Europe and North America.

name.justification: mUNITER, a multilingual vision-and-language model, is analyzed for its performance on the MaRVL dataset.
name.quote: The UNITER architecture consists of a stack of Transformer layers similar to BERTBASE, whose input is the concatenation of language and vision embeddings.
